primary_source.permission_scope: Repository declaration only; external dependencies and model artifacts require separate review.

stage_review.correction: The source trains an EfficientNet-B5 slope predictor from random weights with a tabular side input, noise and dropout. It is not a frozen pretrained feature extractor for the quantile branch.

Keep branch-specific feature preparation, longitudinal response construction, population selection and preprocessing state explicit. The source removes a previously used covariate; generic baseline/delta descriptions do not specify the full preparation.
Concatenation occurs inside the image predictor. The final solution blends two separate predictors; the intake incorrectly routes extracted image features into the quantile model.

The source uses TensorFlow/Keras, two hidden dense layers, a mixed quantile and clipped likelihood loss, two folds and 600 epochs. An unconstrained base head plus cumulative nonnegative increments does not guarantee ordered predictions.
Qualify both branches and the final prediction/confidence blend. A single quantile-spread conversion does not cover the complete source computation; spread is also not proof of calibrated coverage.

synthetic_head_check.backend: NumPy evaluation of pinned cumulative-sum expression; not TensorFlow training qualification

reuse_requirements: Separate image preprocessing, tabular preparation, slope fitting, trajectory extrapolation, quantile fitting, uncertainty calculation and final blending.
Expose coordinates, time units, prediction availability, image geometry, random state, fitted transforms and blend coefficients.
Preserve source output behavior, including possible crossings; do not silently sort predictions or claim guaranteed interval coverage.
Keep clinical response construction and cohort policies in adapters; demonstrate numerical reuse on distinct synthetic applications.
remaining: Pin and inspect every executable cell needed for training and inference, including branch-specific preprocessing and final blending.
Resolve historical dependency semantics, especially optimizer decay, image library behavior and random initialization.
Preserve the complete 30-epoch image schedule and two-fold 600-epoch quantile schedule with bounded resources.
Qualify reusable operations and domain adapters, then execute the complete corrected graph with synthetic inputs.
Pass dependency, metadata, rollback and served-selection gates under the original intake identity.
limitations: Source review and synthetic head counterexample only; no complete workflow, clinical validity or historical accuracy claim.
No source notebook outputs or real records are included in this report.
Quantile-head arithmetic is checked with NumPy; TensorFlow numerical and gradient parity remain unqualified.
